name: Islandora Mirador
project_description:
This is a Drupal module that wraps around the Mirador image viewer. It does not strictly require Islandora, however it depends on an IIIF Manifest . Islandora generates these manifests but they can also come from third-party sources.

 Development is done on Github.com so please contribute PRs there rather than MRs here.

 Features 
 This module provides a block that can be placed, which requires the URL of an IIIF manifest. The block then renders the content from the IIIF manifest in a Mirador viewer. 

 This module also provides a field formatter.

 Post-Installation 
 Enable available plugins and configure the path to the IIIF Manifest view (used by the field formatter but not the block) at Configuration > Media > Mirador settings.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module uses a hosted version of the compiled Mirador library by default. You can also set it to use a local version of the app.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This module works well with Islandora IIIF, which is a submodule of Islandora . 

 Similar projects 
 OpenSeadragon provides comparable functionality for the OpenSeadragon viewer. 

 Supporting this Module 
 Join the Islandora community!

If you like, donate to the Islandora Foundation .
